text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the MVP for the field pilot I called 'priority splitter' in the Optimize toolkit. Field asks are: per-route batching guidance, prefix/KV caching hints, quantization profiles (safe defaults), and eval-triggered alerts. Can we scope a launchable chunk for the next sprint?
Liam: @Maya +1. Doable if we cut the auto-quant pipeline and leave manual recommendations for MVP. Need concrete acceptance criteria.
Priya: Customer asks (AcmeHealth, LexaAI, Travelly) all want low-risk quant guidance and an eval alert when quality regresses on their core prompt set. They prefer a non-invasive rollout.
Carlos: For Dedicated customers we should expose a config toggle (optimize.mode: advisory|auto). MVP = advisory only.
Zoe: Telemetry question — what signals do we need from infra? p95 latency, token-rate, batch-size histogram, cache hit rate, and eval concordance metrics. Also need a small API surface to upload prompt sets for eval alerts.
Maya: Suggested MVP scope (trimmed):
- Advisory recommendations for batching per-route (hint values + expected latency/cost delta)
- Prefix/KV caching advisor with TTL recommendations and estimated hit-rate impact
- Quant recommendation profiles (FP16, Q4_0, Q4_1) with documented risk notes — no auto-apply
- Eval-triggered alerts: customer-uploaded prompt set + threshold on metric drop (concordance/ROUGE-like) -> notify + rollback suggestion
Liam: That looks sensible. Implementation notes: batching advisor = rule-based heuristics + small simulator that estimates cost/latency given model profile. Caching advisor needs lightweight probe workload to estimate prefix reuse.
Priya: For acceptance we should require: 3 pilot customers onboarded, each sees >=15% token-cost reduction estimate from batching+cache for non-chat workloads OR <5% observed quality drop on eval heldout. Also alerts firing correctly on a small staged drift test.
Carlos: SLA gating: for advisory mode we need no infra changes; for rollout we need console UI to toggle advisor per-customer. Also need rollout docs and API schema v1.
Zoe: Data/telemetry gating: we need sample size guidance: at least 1000 requests across varied routes or 24h of traffic, whichever comes first, to trust recommendations. Add a fallback when sample size is low.
EvalBot: automated note: run-eval --customer <id> --promptset v1 --baseline-window=7d -> returns concordance delta. Recommend threshold 0.08 (8%) for alerting default.
Maya: Launch gates proposal (MVP):
- Feature-complete advisory pipeline deployed to staging
- Telemetry collection validating signals for 3 pilot customers
- Pilot onboarding docs + customer-facing risk checklist
- Acceptance: at least 2/3 pilots confirm recommendations are actionable and no major quality regressions (>8% concordance drop)
Liam: Tradeoffs: postpone 'automatic quant apply' and 'autotune batching in runtime' to Phase 2. Also postpone multi-model heuristic (for now, per-model family templates only).
Priya: From field: prioritize AcmeHealth (sensitive data) for private deployment docs and LexaAI for quick feedback loop. Travelly can be our non-critical scale test.
Carlos: Owner assignments:
- Batching advisor engine: @Liam
- Caching advisor + probe: @Carlos
- Quant profiles & docs: @Priya
- Eval-alert pipeline & console: @Zoe
- Pilot onboarding + customer comms: @Maya
Maya: Timeline idea: 2-week spike for simulators/probes, 3-week build, 1-week pilot onboarding window. Total ~6 weeks to initial pilots.
Zoe: QA checklist items: synthetic drift test, perf regression (p99, p95), correctness spot-checks on 50 examples/customer.
Liam: Dev notes: add feature flags: optimize_advisor_mvp=true and eval_alerts_v1_enabled. Keep schema for prompt-sets simple: list of {id, prompt, expected_anchor}.
Priya: Customer-facing acceptance email draft included in notes: short list of actions we expect them to perform + rollback path.
Maya: Decision for today: agree on MVP scope (advisory-only, eval alerts v1, docs + telemetry) and freeze any auto-apply features. If no objections by EOD, I'll lock the spec and open PRs for the spike. :white_check_mark:
Liam: No objections. :thumbsup:
Priya: SGTM.
Carlos: SGTM.
Zoe: SGTM.
Maya: Great — I'll create the spec PR and tag owners. Action items in thread: 1) Liam: prototype batching simulator (due +10d), 2) Carlos: caching probe sketch (+10d), 3) Zoe: eval-alerts contract (+7d), 4) Priya: quant profiles and risk doc (+7d), 5) Maya: pilot comms + onboarding template (+5d).
EvalBot: Note saved to project: optimize/priority-splitter/mvp_spec (automated).
